run_dingtalk_qr_auth: run the interactive DingTalk QR code device-flow authorization to obtain client_id and client_secret
create_begin_registration: create a device-flow registration by calling begin_registration to get device_code and verification_uri_complete
test_poll_registration: test poll_registration with a device_code to check DingTalk authorization status
build_wait_for_registration_success: build a blocking wait for DingTalk registration success using device_code and optional polling callback
review_render_qr_to_terminal: review render_qr_to_terminal to render a DingTalk verification URL as a compact half-block QR code in the terminal
